about: Marks each item of a pick-up split list while its transfer runs. Added by esv::pickup::PickUpExecutionSystem::ProcessTransferRequests (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xD4A630) to every entity of esv::pickup::PickUpSplitListComponent, filled from the request entity and its esv::pickup::PickUpRequestComponent; read by PickUpExecutionFinishedSystem and invisibility::RevealingSystem. Seen.py context: tree3 dialogue UND_PanicRoom_HiddenGnome (item picked up).

evidence.says: ProcessTransferRequests stores at +0 of the new component the query entity (entity list +0x40 at the row index) - the entity that holds the PickUpRequestComponent. Live 0x1470A / 0x0200001C. Game name: member 0 (m_Picker) of savegame model ls::model::game::pickup::v0::BeingPickedUpComponent; matched by the Windows loader bg3.exe+0x258E030 -> bg3.exe+0x2780D80 (model to component): model EntityId +0 -> component +0.

The same function copies the 8 bytes at PickUpRequestComponent+0 (field_0 there) to +8 of the component. Live 0x13727, equal to PickUpRequestComponent+0 of the same step. Game name: member 1 (m_TargetInventory) of savegame model ls::model::game::pickup::v0::BeingPickedUpComponent; matched by the Windows loader bg3.exe+0x258E030 -> bg3.exe+0x2780D80 (model to component): model EntityId +8 -> component +8.

The same function copies the two 8-byte values at PickUpRequestComponent+0x20/+0x28 (target rotation) to +0x10/+0x18 of the component. Live (0, 0.5509, 0, 0.8346). Game name: member 2 (m_OrigRotation) of savegame model ls::model::game::pickup::v0::BeingPickedUpComponent; matched by the Windows loader bg3.exe+0x258E030 -> bg3.exe+0x2780D80 (model to component): model quat +0x10 (transformed) -> component +0x10.

The same function copies the 8 bytes at request+0x30 to +0x20 and the dword at request+0x38 to +0x28 (target translation). Live (-525.5, 28.8, 465.3). Game name: member 3 (m_OrigTranslation) of savegame model ls::model::game::pickup::v0::BeingPickedUpComponent; matched by the Windows loader bg3.exe+0x258E030 -> bg3.exe+0x2780D80 (model to component): model vec3 +0x20 (transformed) -> component +0x20.

Qword +0x2C = PickUpRequestComponent+0x10 (Optional<int> value + presence). Live 0. Game name: member 4 (m_AmountToPickUp) of savegame model ls::model::game::pickup::v0::BeingPickedUpComponent; matched by the Windows loader bg3.exe+0x258E030 -> bg3.exe+0x2780D80 (model to component): model int32 +0x2C -> component +0x2C when model +0x34 is set.

Presence byte of that Optional<int>. Live 0x00 (+0x31..+0x33 garbage 00 c0 ff).
